cmd:
python -c '
import os, sys, tempfile, traceback, warnings
from PIL import Image
out = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/tmp"), "temp.gif")
im = Image.new("RGB", (256, 1))
for x in range(256):
    im.putpixel((x, 0), (x, 0, 0))
im.info["transparency"] = (255, 255, 255)
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter("always")
    try:
        im.save(out)
    except TypeError as exc:
        fr = traceback.extract_tb(exc.__traceback__)[-1]
        print("BASE BUG REPRODUCED: TypeError:", exc)
        print("raised at:", fr.filename, fr.lineno, fr.name, "|", fr.line)
        print("warnings:", [str(w.message) for w in caught])
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as exc:
        print("OTHER EXCEPTION:", type(exc).__name__, exc)
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(3)
print("warnings:", [str(w.message) for w in caught])
with Image.open(out) as re:
    re.load()
    print("saved OK:", re.format, re.mode, re.size, re.info.get("version"))
    print("transparency in reloaded info:", "transparency" in re.info)
    rgb = re.convert("RGB")
    print("info only: distinct colors =", len(rgb.getcolors(256) or []), "; pixel(200,0) =", rgb.getpixel((200, 0)))
    ok = "transparency" not in re.info
sys.exit(0 if ok else 2)
'

cmd:
python -c '
import os, sys, tempfile, traceback, warnings
from PIL import Image
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/tmp")

def red_ramp():
    im = Image.new("RGB", (256, 1))
    for x in range(256):
        im.putpixel((x, 0), (x, 0, 0))
    return im

def attempt(label, im, **kw):
    out = os.path.join(d, label + ".gif")
    err = None
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        try:
            im.save(out, **kw)
        except Exception as exc:
            fr = traceback.extract_tb(exc.__traceback__)[-1]
            err = "%s: %s @ %s:%s %s" % (type(exc).__name__, exc, os.path.basename(fr.filename), fr.lineno, fr.name)
    ws = [str(w.message) for w in caught]
    if err:
        print("[%s] RAISED %s | warnings=%s" % (label, err, ws))
        return
    with Image.open(out) as re:
        print("[%s] saved | n_frames=%s | reloaded transparency=%s | warnings=%s" % (label, getattr(re, "n_frames", 1), re.info.get("transparency", "<absent>"), ws))

a = red_ramp()
a.info["transparency"] = (255, 255, 255)
attempt("A_example_save_all_single_frame", a, save_all=True)

b = Image.open("Tests/images/hopper.ppm").convert("RGB")
b.info["transparency"] = b.getpixel((0, 0))
attempt("B_hopper_rgb_tuple", b)

c = Image.new("RGB", (1, 1))
c.info["transparency"] = (255, 0, 0)
attempt("C_small_rgb_tuple_allocatable", c)

attempt("D_example_tuple_as_save_kwarg", red_ramp(), transparency=(255, 255, 255))

e2 = red_ramp()
e2.info["transparency"] = (255, 255, 255)
attempt("E_example_two_frames", e2, save_all=True, append_images=[Image.new("RGB", (256, 1))])

with Image.open("Tests/images/rgb_trns.png") as f:
    f.load()
    print("[F] source mode=%s size=%s transparency=%r" % (f.mode, f.size, f.info.get("transparency")))
    attempt("F_rgb_trns_png", f)
'
